output_policy: All listed output paths belong to the proposed folder. Each bound includes 4096-byte file rounding. Bounded writers and closure reservation are required before activation. Refuse excess output; never discard old evidence or report truncated output as success.
activation_requires: An independently reviewed wrapper that retains all 28 existing checks and adds the new folder check.
An independently reviewed census that charges actual new records plus the unused new folder allowance.
A complete fresh capacity result and passing closure under unchanged resource limits.
Explicit stage output bindings without changes to saved runtime paths or old attempt markers.
Fresh folder checks before writes, during execution, and after child cleanup.
A decision on any separately blocked Windows security action before simulated work.
